c: Toast flour dry in a heavy pan, stirring, 15–20 min to hazelnut brown; cool.
Melt butter; add sliced onion and the roasted flour; cook 2 min.
Whisk in wine and stock; add bay and clove; simmer 1 h, stirring.
Strain; season; serve with grated Gruyère.

Add rinsed barley, stock and bay; simmer 1 h until barley is soft.
Add diced air-dried beef and cabbage for the last 15 min.
f97756ac.al: 1 Gluten (pearl barley) · 7 Milk (butter, cream 35%) · 9 Celery (celeriac, beef stock). Contains 9 Celery.

fb736dce.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: 2 dumplings + 300 g broth ≈ 420 g

Whisk milk and eggs; pour over bread with speck, onion, herbs; rest 30 min.
Add flour; shape 20 firm balls × 60 g with wet hands.
Poach in barely simmering salted water 15 min (test one first).
Bring the broth to the boil; season.
2 canederli per hot bowl; 300 g broth; chives.

Divide 170 g; roll paper-thin (2 mm) on baking paper to 30 × 20 cm.
Season crème fraîche with nutmeg, pepper and salt; spread 80 g thinly to the edges.
Scatter very finely sliced raw onion and lardons.
Bake on a preheated stone/deck 280 °C 6–8 min (convection 250 °C 10 min) until the edges blister and char.
Finish with chives; cut into 8; serve at once.
Whisk flour, milk, eggs, salt and butter smooth; rest 20 min; add chopped parsley.
Cook thin pancakes in a lightly oiled pan; cool; roll; cut 3 mm strips.
Simmer julienne carrot and celeriac in the broth 3 min; season.
Place 40 g frittaten in each hot bowl; ladle broth over; chives.
15ccdc5b.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour) · 3 Eggs (eggs) · 7 Milk (milk 3%, butter) · 9 Celery (beef stock, celeriac). Contains 9 Celery.

c: Cut beef into 1.5 cm cubes. Sweat diced onion in oil 12 min until golden.
Off the heat stir in paprika and crushed caraway (paprika burns easily); add beef, garlic and tomato paste; cook 5 min.
Add water and bay; simmer covered 1 h 15 min.
Add diced peppers and potatoes (1.5 cm); simmer 25 min until beef is tender.
Finish with marjoram, vinegar, salt and pepper. Serve with bread and sour cream.
293e628f.st: 0–4 °C 3 days (better next day); freeze 2 months; reheat core ≥ 75 °C.

7927ad78.yl: Yield: 10 portions (20 dumplings) · Portion: 2 dumplings + 250 g broth

Shape 20 balls; flatten to 2 cm patties.
Fry in oil 2–3 min each side until golden; drain.
Bring clear beef broth to the boil; season.
Simmer patties in the broth 3 min; serve 2 per bowl with chives.
7927ad78.al: 1 Gluten (white bread) · 3 Eggs (eggs) · 7 Milk (milk 3%, butter, appenzeller, quark) · 9 Celery (beef stock). Contains 9 Celery (broth).

5d9731c5.yl: Yield: 10 portions (10 dumplings) · Portion: 1 dumpling + 250 g broth
c: Slice rolls thinly; soak in warm milk.
Mix with liver, mince, sweated onion, eggs, crumbs, marjoram, zest, parsley and seasoning; rest 20 min.
Shape 10 dumplings; simmer in salted water 20 min (do not boil).
Serve each dumpling in 250 g hot clear broth; chives.
5d9731c5.al: 1 Gluten (bread rolls, breadcrumbs) · 3 Eggs (eggs) · 7 Milk (milk 3%, butter) · 9 Celery (beef stock). Contains 9 Celery (broth).

Cut bread into 20 rounds Ø 6 cm; dome 30 g cheese mix on each, pressing it to the edges.
Fry cheese side down at 175 °C 1–2 min until puffed and golden; turn 20 s; drain.
Serve hot with gherkins and pickled onions.
e547f8ec.st: Raw prepared: 0–4 °C, 12 h. Fry to order.
e547f8ec.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour, white bread) · 3 Eggs (eggs) · 7 Milk (gruyère) · 14 Sulphites (white wine). Vegetarian.

2df73ef6.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: 80 g Obatzda + garnish
c: Mash ripe camembert (rind on) with butter and cream cheese.
Add very finely chopped onion, paprika, ground caraway and beer; season.
Rest 2 h at 4 °C to set the flavour.
Shape quenelles of Obatzda; sprinkle chives and paprika.
Serve with warm pretzel, sliced radish and onion rings.
2df73ef6.al: 1 Gluten (lager beer, soft pretzels) · 7 Milk (camembert, butter, cream cheese). Vegetarian.

Whisk in oil to an emulsion; season with pepper.
Boil potatoes in their skins; slice warm 1 cm.
Render lardons until crisp; fry diced baguette in the fat and butter.
Toss leaves with half the vinaigrette; warm potatoes and lardons with the rest.
Plate leaves, potatoes and lardons; top with Beaufort shavings, walnuts, croûtons and chives.
38729d94.al: 1 Gluten (baguette) · 7 Milk (beaufort, butter) · 8 Nuts (walnuts) · 10 Mustard (dijon mustard) · 14 Sulphites (red wine vinegar)

c: Sweat sliced leek and onion in butter 10 min without colour.
Add diced root vegetables and stock; simmer 30 min.
Add milk and cream; blend coarse or smooth; season with nutmeg.
Slice baguette; toast; top with grated Beaufort; gratinate. Float on the soup.
5023d144.al: 1 Gluten (baguette) · 7 Milk (butter, milk 3%, cream 35%, beaufort) · 9 Celery (celeriac, vegetable stock). Vegetarian. Contains 9 Celery.

c: Slice speck and ham very thinly; cut cheese into batons.
Arrange on wooden boards with gherkins, onions, radish, butter and fresh horseradish.
Serve sliced rye bread alongside; chives over the butter.

12c20866.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: 220 g pork + 80 g gravy
c: Score rind in 1 cm diamonds; rub meat (not rind) with salt, crushed caraway, garlic and pepper.
Place rind down in 2 cm water; roast 160 °C 30 min; turn rind up; add vegetables.
Roast 160 °C 2 h 30 min, basting with beer; then 220 °C 20 min (or grill) until the rind puffs into crackling.
Strain juices with stock; reduce; thicken lightly; season. Slice; serve with Semmelknödel and red cabbage.
12c20866.al: 1 Gluten (dark lager beer) · 9 Celery (celeriac, beef stock). Contains 9 Celery.

Sweat sliced onion and lardons in butter until golden; deglaze with wine.
Mix crozets, onion-lardon mix and cream; pepper; spread in a gratin dish.
Cover with Reblochon halved horizontally, rind up; bake 200 °C 20–25 min until bubbling and golden.
7c6ba6a2.al: 1 Gluten (crozets) · 3 Eggs (crozets) · 7 Milk (butter, cream 35%, reblochon) · 14 Sulphites (white wine)

62b82502.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: 2 diots + onions & polenta ≈ 400 g
c: Brown diots on all sides in oil; remove.
Sweat sliced onions in butter 15 min until soft and golden.
Return diots; add wine and herbs; cover; simmer 40 min; reduce the liquor at the end.
Whisk polenta into boiling salted water and milk; cook 40 min, stirring; beat in butter.
Beat flour, eggs, milk, water, salt and nutmeg with a wooden spoon until bubbly and elastic; rest 20 min.
Press through a spätzle board or press into boiling salted water; when they float (1–2 min) lift out; refresh or use hot.
Slice onions thin; dust with flour; fry in butter 15–18 min until deep golden and crisp; drain.
Layer hot spätzle and grated cheese in a buttered GN, finishing with cheese.
Bake 200 °C 8–10 min until melted; top with crispy onions, chives and pepper; core ≥ 75 °C.
7040b18d.st: Spätzle 0–4 °C 48 h. Assembled: serve within 1 h; reheat core ≥ 75 °C.

c: Mix flours; add warm water; knead 5 min (short, crumbly dough).
Roll 3 mm; cut strips 7 cm × 1 cm.
Boil potato slices and cabbage ribbons in salted water 5 min; add pasta; cook 10 min more; drain.
Layer in a hot tray: pasta and vegetables, thin Casera slices and Parmesan, 3 layers.
Brown butter with crushed garlic and sage; pour over; mix gently; rest 2 min to melt. Serve very hot.
66bafa83.st: Fresh pasta: 0–4 °C, 48 h. Cook to order.
66bafa83.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour) · 7 Milk (valtellina casera, butter, parmesan). Vegetarian (check rennet).

a58b5264.yl: Yield: 10 portions (20 dumplings) · Portion: 2 dumplings + 150 g kraut
c: Dice bread 1 cm; pour over warm milk beaten with eggs; rest 20 min.
Sweat diced speck and onion in butter; add with herbs, flour and seasoning; mix.
Shape 20 dumplings with wet hands; simmer in salted water 15 min.
Sweat onion in lard; add rinsed sauerkraut, grated apple, spices, wine and stock; braise 40 min.
Serve dumplings on kraut drizzled with brown butter and chives.
a58b5264.al: 1 Gluten (bread rolls, wheat flour) · 3 Eggs (eggs) · 7 Milk (milk 3%, butter) · 9 Celery (vegetable stock) · 14 Sulphites (white wine)

14d219d2.yl: Yield: 1 GN 1/1 × 65 mm · 12 portions · Portion: ≈ 280 g
c: Boil potatoes in skins 18–20 min until just tender; peel; slice 1 cm.
Render lardons 5 min; add sliced onion and butter, cook 10 min until golden; add garlic and wine, reduce by half.
Layer in a buttered GN: potatoes, onion-lardon mix, crème fraîche; season lightly (Reblochon is salty).
Halve the Reblochon horizontally, cut into wedges; lay rind-up over the top.
Bake 200 °C convection 20–25 min until bubbling and golden; core ≥ 75 °C. Serve with green salad.
14d219d2.al: 7 Milk (butter, crème fraîche 30%, reblochon) · 14 Sulphites (white wine)

c: Potatoes 2000 g → ≈ 1700 g; pork 1000 g → ≈ 750 g
Boil potatoes in skins; chill; peel; slice 5 mm. Roast or use left-over roast pork; cut 1 cm.
Fry potatoes in lard on a large plancha until crisp and golden; add lardons, sliced onion and pork; fry 8 min.
Season with caraway, marjoram, salt and pepper; parsley.
Serve in the pan topped with a fried egg; side salad.

d312b082.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: 160 g raw → ≈ 200 g fried + lemon
c: Pound escalopes between film to 4 mm; season just before crumbing.
Dust in flour, pull through beaten egg, lay in crumbs without pressing (keeps the coat loose).
Fry 2 min per side, swirling the pan so fat washes over the top and the crumb soufflés; core ≥ 75 °C.
Drain on paper; serve at once with lemon wedges and parsley; potato salad or parsley potatoes on the side.
d312b082.st: Raw escalopes 0–4 °C 48 h. Crumb and fry to order.
d312b082.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour, breadcrumbs) · 3 Eggs (eggs) · 7 Milk (clarified butter)

7e92b710.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: 180 g beef + sauces + vegetables
c: Halve onion; char cut side dry. Put beef and marrow bones into boiling water; skim; reduce to a bare simmer.
Add onion, pepper and bay; simmer 2 h 30 min; add vegetables 40 min before the end; salt.
Slice beef across the grain 1 cm; serve in a copper pot with broth, vegetables and marrow on toast; chives.
Apfelkren: grate apples; mix with horseradish, lemon, sugar and salt.
Chive sauce: blend soaked bread and hard-boiled yolks with vinegar; emulsify with oil; add chopped whites and chives; season.
7e92b710.al: 1 Gluten (white bread) · 3 Eggs (eggs) · 7 Milk (milk 3%) · 9 Celery (celeriac) · 14 Sulphites (white wine vinegar). Contains 9 Celery.

c: Boil potatoes in skins 15 min (half-cooked); chill overnight; peel; grate coarsely.
Fry in clarified butter in a pan, pressing to a cake 2 cm, 10 min each side until golden; salt.
Cut veal into thin strips 5 × 1 cm; dust lightly with flour.
Sear in very hot clarified butter in batches 1 min; set aside.
Sauté shallot and sliced mushrooms; add wine; reduce; add stock and cream; reduce to coating.
Return veal 1 min without boiling; lemon, season, parsley. Serve with rösti.
acb562f8.st: Cook to order. Rösti mix: 0–4 °C, 48 h.
acb562f8.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour) · 7 Milk (clarified butter, cream 35%) · 9 Celery (veal stock) · 14 Sulphites (white wine). Contains 9 Celery (stock).

c: Cook diced apples with sugar, water, lemon and cinnamon 15 min; mash coarsely; serve warm or cold.
Cook diced potatoes and macaroni together in salted water ≈ 10 min; drain.
Heat cream and milk; add grated cheeses; fold in pasta and potatoes.
Fry sliced onions and lardons in butter until crisp and golden.
Serve in hot dishes topped with crispy onions; apple sauce alongside.
f8a53f78.al: 1 Gluten (macaroni) · 7 Milk (cream 35%, milk 3%, appenzeller, gruyère, butter)

b10de62b.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: 150 g cheese + garnish
c: Rub 10 small baking dishes with garlic; fill with thin slices of Abondance (rind removed).
Pour 15 g Madeira over each; pepper.
Bake 220 °C 10–12 min until bubbling and golden.
Serve with potatoes boiled in their skins, ham, gherkins and salad.

85a61c3a.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: ≈ 180 g fondue + 100 g bread + 100 g potatoes
c: Coarsely grate both cheeses; toss with corn starch.
Rub the caquelon with cut garlic; heat wine and lemon to a simmer.
Add cheese by handfuls, stirring in a figure-of-eight on low heat until smooth (do not boil, 70–75 °C).
Stir in kirsch, nutmeg and pepper; serve on a burner at a gentle simmer; stir from time to time.
Cut day-old baguette into 2.5 cm cubes, each with crust.
Steam baby potatoes in skins 20 min; serve warm in a covered basket.
Serve with gherkins and pickled onions; long fondue forks.
85a61c3a.st: Grated cheese mix 0–4 °C 3 days. Fondue: serve at once; leftovers discarded.

c: Toast 2 slices of bread per portion; rub with garlic; place in buttered gratin dishes; sprinkle with wine.
Cover with a slice of ham and 80 g grated Gruyère; pepper and paprika.
Bake 220 °C 10–12 min until melted and golden.
Top with a fried egg; gherkins alongside.
cb17ce6e.al: 1 Gluten (white bread) · 3 Eggs (eggs) · 7 Milk (gruyère, butter) · 14 Sulphites (white wine)

3f2abd46.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: 200 g beef + 100 g sauces
c: Pot oil 1500 g per 3 pots, reusable after filtering
Cut chilled beef into 2.5 cm cubes; dry well; 200 g per guest.
Heat 500 g oil per fondue pot to 180 °C in the kitchen; keep hot on the burner (fill max 1/3; never add water).
Guests cook cubes on forks 30–60 s; season at the table.
Cocktail: mayo + ketchup + Cognac. Curry: mayo + curry powder + chutney.
Tartare: mayo + capers + gherkins + tarragon. Horseradish: whipped cream + horseradish + salt.
Serve 4 sauces in small bowls per table.
Whisk yolks, mustard, vinegar and salt; emulsify with oil.
3f2abd46.al: 3 Eggs (egg yolks) · 7 Milk (cream 35%) · 10 Mustard (curry powder, dijon mustard) · 14 Sulphites (white wine vinegar). Hot-oil safety: stable burner, 1 pot per 4 guests.

f64edf3a.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: 200 g meat + garnish
c: Simmer stock with wine, sliced vegetables, garlic and spices 20 min; season; keep at a simmer on the burner.
Partially freeze meats 1 h; slice 2 mm; fan on cold plates (chicken separately).
Guests cook slices in the simmering broth 20–40 s (chicken until white through, 1–2 min).
Serve with rice, mushrooms, pickles and the Bourguignonne sauces; drink the broth at the end.
f64edf3a.al: 9 Celery (beef stock, celeriac) · 14 Sulphites (white wine). Contains 9 Celery. Serve with sauces from Fondue Bourguignonne TTK.

c: Rub the caquelon with garlic; heat wine and lemon until steaming.
Add grated cheeses gradually, stirring in a figure of eight, without boiling.
Mix starch with kirsch; stir in; cook 2–3 min until smooth and creamy; season. Keep on a burner at a gentle simmer.
Cut bread into 2–3 cm cubes, each with crust; boil potatoes in skins; serve pickles on the side.
15027a58.st: Serve at once; leftover fondue: 0–4 °C, 48 h.
15027a58.al: 1 Gluten (baguette) · 7 Milk (gruyère, vacherin fribourgeois) · 14 Sulphites (white wine). Vegetarian. Contains alcohol.

e1657502.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: 200 g cheese + 200 g potatoes + garnish
c: ½ wheel or 2 kg for 10 guests
Remove the cheese 1 h before service; trim the rind edge if hard.
Melt the cut face under the raclette grill 2–3 min until bubbling and lightly browned.
Scrape 60–70 g per plate at a time; finish with pepper and paprika; serve at once.
Boil or steam potatoes in skins with salt 20–22 min; keep hot ≥ 63 °C in a covered basket.
Fan cured meats on a chilled board ≤ 5 °C; gherkins and onions in bowls.
e1657502.st: Cheese 0–4 °C wrapped 3 weeks. Meats ≤ 5 °C at the station, max 2 h.

c: Quarter cabbage, remove core; cut 2 cm ribbons; blanch 2 min; refresh; drain well.
Render lardons; add butter and sliced onion 5 min.
Add cabbage, caraway and stock; braise covered 8–10 min until tender but still green.
Uncover; reduce the liquid to a glaze; season with salt, pepper and nutmeg.
Beat flour, eggs, water, salt and nutmeg to a bubbly, elastic batter; rest 20 min.
Press through a spätzle board or press into boiling salted water; lift when they float; refresh.
Toss in foaming brown butter to order; parsley.

76673445.yl: Yield: 1 mould 2 L = 12 portions · Portion: ≈ 150 g
c: Mix with eggs, cream, milk, flour, chopped prunes, raisins, lardons, sugar and seasoning.
Line a buttered mould with bacon slices; fill; cover.
Bake in a bain-marie 160 °C 3 h; rest 15 min; unmould; slice.
76673445.st: 0–4 °C, 3 days; reheat slices in a pan.

c: Butter a gratin dish; rub with garlic.
Layer 3 mm potato slices with grated Beaufort, seasoning and butter flakes.
Pour hot stock to just below the top layer; finish with cheese and butter.
Bake 180 °C 1 h 15 min until tender and golden; rest 10 min.
dc11c662.al: 7 Milk (butter, beaufort) · 9 Celery (beef stock). Contains 9 Celery (stock).

c: Bring salted water to the boil; rain in mixed cornmeal and buckwheat, whisking.
Cook 45–50 min over low heat, stirring often, until thick.
Beat in butter (browned with sage) and diced cheese until melted and stringy.
Warm the clarified butter, duck fat, shallot and herbs over low heat for 1–2 min without colour.
Grate the potatoes coarsely; squeeze out the liquid in a cloth.
Mix with two-thirds of the aromatic fat; season with the salt and pepper.
Heat the remaining fat in a pan; press in a 1 cm disc.
Fry over medium heat for 6–7 min per side until a firm golden crust forms.
Finish in the oven at 180 °C convection for 6–8 min.
Brush with the butter, add a few drops of truffle oil and the microgreens. Serve at once.
ebe5fa50.st: Aromatic fat: 0–4 °C, 1 week. Rösti: cook to order.

c: Slice rolls thinly; pour warm milk over; rest 15 min.
Add sweated onion, eggs, parsley and seasoning; knead lightly; add crumbs if soft.
Shape 10 dumplings with wet hands; simmer in salted water 20 min (do not boil).
5a6b0b88.al: 1 Gluten (bread rolls, breadcrumbs) · 3 Eggs (eggs) · 7 Milk (milk 3%, butter). Vegetarian.

c: Knead 8–10 min to a smooth, elastic dough; divide into 4, brush with oil, cover and rest 1 h at room temperature.
Stretch each piece paper-thin on a floured cloth to ≈ 80 × 60 cm; trim the thick edge.
Toast breadcrumbs in butter until golden; cool.
Slice apples 3 mm; toss with lemon juice, sugar, cinnamon and raisins just before filling.
Brush each dough sheet with butter; scatter ¼ of the crumbs over the lower third, then ¼ of the apples.
Fold in the sides, roll up with the cloth, set seam down on a lined tray; brush with butter.
Bake at 190 °C convection 35–40 min, brushing once, until deep golden and the apples are soft.
Cool 20 min; dust with icing sugar; cut 12 slices per strudel. Serve warm (≥ 63 °C if held hot) or at room temperature.
1abbb1fb.st: Baked strudel: 0–4 °C, 48 h (re-crisp at 170 °C 8 min); −18 °C unbaked, 1 month.

642f448e.yl: Yield: 1 tart Ø 24 cm = 16 slices · Portion: ≈ 60 g
c: Rub butter, sugar and flour; add egg, salt and zest; bring together; chill 1 h.
Cook sugar to a medium caramel; add hot cream and honey carefully; boil 2 min; stir in walnuts; cool.
Line a Ø 24 cm ring with 2/3 of the pastry 4 mm; fill; cover with a lid; seal; prick; egg-wash.
Bake 180 °C 35–40 min; cool completely before cutting (best next day).
642f448e.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour) · 3 Eggs (eggs) · 7 Milk (butter, cream 35%) · 8 Nuts (walnuts). Vegetarian.

c: Knead flour, yeast in warm milk, egg, yolks, sugar, salt, butter and zest 10 min; rise 45 min.
Divide 90 g; flatten; place 25 g powidl in the centre; seal; shape balls seam down; prove 30 min.
Steam 15 min (or simmer covered in salted water 7 min each side).
Melt butter with vanilla; mix poppy seeds with icing sugar.
Pour butter over the hot dumpling; sprinkle generously with poppy sugar.
e5c297f2.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour) · 3 Eggs (eggs, egg yolks) · 7 Milk (milk 3%, butter). Vegetarian.

7a0c74b7.yl: Yield: 1 cake Ø 24 cm = 12 portions · Portion: ≈ 50 g
c: Butter and flour a tall Savoie mould.
Beat yolks, sugar, vanilla and zest until pale and thick.
Whisk whites with salt to firm peaks; fold into yolks alternately with sifted flour and starch.
Bake 165 °C 40–45 min until a skewer comes out clean; unmould onto a rack; dust with icing sugar.
7a0c74b7.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour) · 3 Eggs (egg yolks, egg whites) · 7 Milk (butter). Vegetarian.

c: Heat apple juice, water, orange juice and honey with spices to 75 °C; do not boil.
Add orange and lemon slices; infuse 15 min.
Serve in mugs with an apple slice; hold at 70 °C max 3 h.
e718d42c.al: None of the 14 declared allergens. Vegan if made without honey. Alcohol-free.

c: Whisk cocoa, sugar, starch and salt with 300 ml cold milk to a paste.
Bring remaining milk and cream to a simmer; whisk in the paste; simmer 2 min until lightly thickened.
Off the heat whisk in chopped chocolate and vanilla until smooth; hold at 70 °C, stirring.
Whip cream with icing sugar to soft peaks; 20 g on each cup; dust with cocoa.
Whisk yolks, milk, flour, vanilla and salt smooth; whisk whites with sugar to soft peaks; fold in.
Pour 2 cm into foaming butter in pans; scatter raisins; cook 3 min; bake 180 °C 6–8 min until risen.
Tear into pieces with 2 forks; caramelise with butter and icing sugar 1 min; dust.
Simmer chopped prunes with powidl, water and spices 10 min; serve warm.
983d9d9d.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour) · 3 Eggs (egg yolks, egg whites) · 7 Milk (milk 3%, butter). Vegetarian.

c: Mix flour, nuts, cocoa, spices, baking powder and salt; rub in cold butter; add sugar, zest and eggs; bring together. Chill 1 h.
Roll ⅔ of the dough 5 mm and line the frame; roll the rest 4 mm and cut 1.5 cm strips.
Spread the jam over the base; lay the strips as a lattice; brush with egg wash.
Bake at 170 °C convection 40–45 min until golden.
Cool completely (ideally rest 24 h for flavour); dust the edge with icing sugar; cut 48 pieces.
eb5ada6f.st: Baked torte: covered, room temperature, 5 days or 0–4 °C, 10 days; −18 °C, 2 months.

656f0ff4.yl: Yield: 10 portions (20 dumplings) · Portion: 2 pcs ≈ 200 g

Stone apricots; replace each stone with a sugar cube (2 g sugar).
Wrap each apricot in 40 g dough; seal into balls.
Simmer in lightly salted water 12–14 min until they float.
Toast crumbs in butter until golden; add sugar and cinnamon.
Roll drained dumplings in crumbs; dust with icing sugar.
656f0ff4.st: Raw dumplings: −18 °C, 1 month (cook from frozen 18 min).
656f0ff4.al: 1 Gluten (semolina, wheat flour, breadcrumbs) · 3 Eggs (eggs) · 7 Milk (quark, butter). Vegetarian.

c: Make a syrup: simmer water, sugar, spices, ginger and orange-lemon peel 10 min.
Add orange juice, sliced oranges and wine; heat to 70–75 °C (never boil: alcohol and aroma evaporate). Infuse 20 min.
Strain; hold in a dispenser at 65–70 °C max 4 h.
Serve in glass mugs with a fresh orange slice and cinnamon stick.
79a46bcb.al: 14 Sulphites (red wine). Contains alcohol: 18+ only. Non-alcoholic version: replace wine with red grape juice + hibiscus tea.

81297069.yl: Yield: Frame 40 × 30 cm · 48 pieces 5 × 5 cm · Portion: 68 g
c: Batch · 1 frame · Batter ≈ 2350 g · Yield ≈ 2050 g baked
Beat butter and icing sugar until pale; add yolks gradually, then the chocolate.
Whip whites with salt and sugar to soft, glossy peaks.
Fold whites and sifted flour alternately into the chocolate base.
Bake in the lined frame at 165 °C convection 40–45 min (skewer clean). Cool overnight wrapped; split in two.
Warm and pass the jam. Spread 200 g between the layers; brush 300 g hot over top and sides; set 1 h.
Bring cream and glucose to 85 °C, pour over chocolate, emulsify; pour at 35 °C over the jam layer in one go.
